verses.pali: “Sappaccayā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no appaccayā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with a reason, not without a reason.

verses.pali: Tasseva paccayassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that reason, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
